summary.name: Cubist Painted Collage, an Illustration and Art Media style with extracted provenance from sampled Fable gallery video frames inspected on 2026-10-13. Medium labels are authored classifications.
summary.visualIdentity: Intersecting planar facets show one subject from several viewpoints, with compressed space, muted ochre, gray and brown paint, and selective printed-paper fragments. Recognizable subject anchors must survive fragmentation. Low-poly 3D alone does not establish Cubism.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: the preview subject is a still life of guitar, bottle, glass and table edge. The Phrase Scatter motion reference lists this style as a compatible fit. Inferred: multi-view subject studies and explanatory pieces where a recognizable object benefits from several angles. Other subjects are unspecified.
summary.limitations: The procedural preview only approximates the medium. Photographed or physical collage is a full-video option, not the preview default. Krita-painted plane textures are runtime unverified. Perspective cameras, random shattering and Delaunator triangles are explicitly ruled out. Exact hex values are suggested defaults, not measured source values, and the source prompt is partial.
summary.palette: Authored fallback tokens: background #DED5BB (paper or painted field), foreground #332E29 (outlines and text), ochre #AD9369, gray #85867D, umber #705F4B and paper #ECE4D0. Approved task or reference colors take precedence. Gradients are disabled, so use pigment layering and texture. Normal text needs a 4.5 contrast target measured over the actual textured composite; move captions onto an approved backing if needed.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Preview timing: 0–1.2s facets slide into registration from authored per-view offsets; 1.2–2.0s the bottle's profile facet trades opacity and offset with its top-view facet; 2.0–3.0s holds a readable composition. Use fixed-value GSAP tweens on group transforms. Keep deliberate sharp cuts and reading holds unsmoothed. User interaction is unspecified.
summary.audio: Audio direction is unspecified for this style, and no soundtrack should be assumed from the visual medium. Music, voiceover, ambience or silence should be proposed per task with stated assumptions. Honor supplied audio and silent catalog previews. Do not invent audio assets, and keep speech intelligible without competing vocals.
summary.assetRequirements: Preview needs still-life parts (guitar, bottle, glass, table edge), each drawn from 2–3 viewpoints (profile, top ellipse, frontal). Paper.js output must be cached as SVG path data with part and view IDs. Each facet needs a seeded Canvas 2D scumble texture. Printed-paper fragments carry approved words only, otherwise a plain ruled newsprint pattern. Full video may use approved paper scans, hand-drawn cutouts, or photographed physical collage.
summary.combinations: Cubist Painted Collage must remain dominant, and approved palette colors must be preserved. Style-045 is a suggested supporting style for a secondary detail only, with its role otherwise unspecified. Phrase Scatter motion (motion-037) is optional and applies only when the scene contains the phrase or mark it acts on. Avoid generic effects replacing mark-making and avoid invented historical text.
summary.productionApproach: Visual construction uses SVG for crisp facet edges and Canvas 2D for cached paint textures. Paper.js runs once at build time in an isolated PaperScope for boolean geometry prep only. GSAP drives a paused, seekable motion timeline. HyperFrames is the primary composition and export pipeline, and Remotion is a fallback only with a recorded reason. chroma-js is optional for color and contrast checks. Verify decoded frames and forward, backward and direct seeks.
